handoff: AC1, AC2 met: handoff resolved by unit via handoffPath(specDir, unit); record-keyed helpers removed and linted; all tiers green, no golden/transcript/snapshot change. 3 non-blocking findings.

findings.title: Tests edited for the new resolver signature
findings.detail:
AC1 says 'every test passes unchanged'. Eight call sites in tests (human.test.ts 400/409/418/426-427, agent-protocol.test.ts 378, slice-workflow.test.ts 731, store snapshot/markdown-unit tests) were rewritten from handoffPath(runsDir) to handoffPath(specDir, unit). Assertions and expected paths are unchanged, so behaviour is pinned the same; only the API call moved.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed; accept as the mechanical consequence of the signature change.

findings.title: `uncommitted` still checks only the record folder (pre-existing)
findings.detail:
facts.ts:159 says 'runs/<unit>/ or handoff.md have uncommitted changes', but the prefix is unitDir(...), so the story's handoff above its round folder is not counted. Not introduced here; it is a natural user of the new resolver for gh-195/07.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: When handoffs move (gh-195/07), also test the resolved handoff path here.

findings.title: startedPaths decides inclusion by string prefix
findings.detail:
loc.handoffFile.startsWith(`${loc.runsDir}/`) is correct for the absolute joined paths produced today; it relies on both being built from the same root.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: compare with path.relative to be robust to separators.
